subject: joule v0.1.7 release — interactive GUI graphs and tabs
opening: v0.1.7 ships a richer interactive GUI for normie operators: multi-series live plots with zoom/pan, Overview/Graphs/Donor/Chat tabs, and a fix so gpu_probe env tests stay green under parallel cargo test.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: This release builds on v0.1.6 GUI shell. Primary surface remains `joule` / `joule gui`. Graphs are interactive; donor policy and cluster chat are in-window. Packaging channels (GitHub Releases, Homebrew tap, f00 AUR PKGBUILD) pin 0.1.7 after CI assets land.

sections.heading: Added
items: GUI tabs: Overview, Graphs, Donor, Chat
Multi-series plots: backends, agents, mesh, dht, VRAM, balance, tokens, tok/s, economy window
Zoom, pan, scroll, box-zoom, double-click reset, series toggles, linked time axes, sparklines
Token mix bar chart; balance rate plot
Full donor policy editor (pause, VRAM cap, local schedule, max temp, min battery)
In-app chat against /v1/chat/completions with cached API key
Poll interval slider; start/stop control and agent; force poll; clear history; reset plot views

sections.heading: Fixed
items: gpu_probe env override tests serialized to avoid process-global env races under parallel cargo test
